svg.title: OpenView — clean-room open-source trading workbench
svg.desc: An architecture diagram showing OpenView's React multi-chart frontend, Fastify local bridge, and Rust to WebAssembly TA, Pine v5/v6 compiler, and backtester engine across four global financial markets.

g.text: Clean-room TradingView alternative across four global markets.
01 Web UI React 19 · 2-canvas chart core · 53 drawing tools
02 Bridge Fastify 5 + WS · AES-256-GCM vault · 24/7 alerts
03 WASM Core Rust engine · 18+ TA indicators · Pine v5/v6 VM
04 Markets Crypto · Forex/Metals · US Equities · NSE/BSE/MCX
05 Engine Deterministic strategy backtester + multi-market scan
MIT LICENSED / ZERO-BACKEND STATIC MODE / LOCAL-FIRST BRIDGE
